verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents creating and exporting issues from errors to GitHub, GitLab, and Jira (Cloud and Server), with configurable events that create tickets. That covers the 'link an error to a tracker' part of the story. Nothing shows closing a ticket resolving the error or a regression reopening the linked ticket. Deploy-based auto-resolve and Slack resolve buttons are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: two-way status sync (ticket close → error resolve), regression reopening the linked ticket, Linear integration, and any independent corroboration.
